submitted_runs.latest_observation: Failed before any NeMo-RL acceptance/throughput metric. The concrete failure was MegatronPolicyWorker creation: FileNotFoundError for nrl_megatron_ckpts_20260526/Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B/iter_0000000/run_config.yaml after workers printed 'Checkpoint already exists ... Skipping import.' This was a checkpoint-completion race: validate_model_paths treated the iter_0000000 directory as a complete checkpoint even though run_config.yaml was missing. The remote SpecDec-RL patch now treats a Megatron checkpoint as existing only when iter_0000000/run_config.yaml exists.

specdec_gate.note: Corrected PublicHF diagnostic. The launcher now explicitly passes policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, matching the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 drafter family.

submitted_runs.latest_observation: Submitted after patching the 235B launchers to pass policy.model_name explicitly and patching Megatron checkpoint-complete detection to require iter_0000000/run_config.yaml. At 17:43 PDT the job was still RUNNING after about 77 minutes. Ray workers were online at 128/128, the driver log confirmed policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 plus the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 speculative_config, vLLM V1 engine initialization with enforce_eager=false and CUDA Graph mode, target safetensors loading to 118/118, and the observed 1/1 drafter safetensors load. Step 1/4 and Step 2/4 emitted early SpecDec metrics plus standard Generation Worker Group metrics; Step 3/4 emitted early metrics and was in logprobs at the latest check. No traceback or fatal error was observed. Generated throughput is 63.70, 43.39, then 73.58 generated tok/s/GPU with acceptance 62.82%, 69.01%, then 65.82%. Step 1 and Step 2 completed total-step logging; Step 3 final step metrics are still pending. Scheduler gate metrics show enabled_ratio=1.0 and disabled=0 for Steps 1-3, so this run has the runtime gate configured but has not yet demonstrated lower-batch-only activation. Matched Thinking-2507 baseline job 3088636 is RUNNING and still building/downloading the Python environment, so strict speedup should wait for its baseline throughput and E2E step-time comparison.

gate_metrics_observation.interpretation: Runtime gate is configured, but observed scheduler metrics have not disabled SpecDec so far; do not treat this run as proof of lower-batch-only activation.
